rv.q: You'll be pretty gripped, I think, by a passionate work at the beginning of its journey.
Aksoy's portrayal of Markovic was incredibly haunting and will send chills down your spine.
An Educated Guess is one of those plays that grabs you by your lapels and shakes you to your core.

“An Educated Guess” adeptly encapsulates the conundrum in present day by delving into the psychology of one caught in the middle of tragedy while bringing attention to those that some might wish you would forget.
This is a show that everyone must see!

cn.t: Critics praise this thought-provoking world premiere for its fresh perspective on legal immigration, focusing on the naturalization process rather than border crossings. Alfonso's insightful script personalizes the immigrant experience through compelling narratives.
